Manager and Ground Staff navs working with location tracking 'Active' (no toggle). NEW BUG FOUND: Products and Config tabs crash with 'categories.map is not a function' - backend /api/inv/categories returns dict instead of array.

critical.issue: Returns dictionary (business type structure) instead of array. Frontend ProductsTab.js and InvConfigTab.js call categories.map() expecting array, causing TypeError crash

ui_bugs.issue: TypeError: categories.map is not a function - crashes when clicking Products tab in Director Inventory
Same categories.map error - crashes when clicking Config tab in Director Inventory

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix /api/inv/categories to return an array of category objects (e.g., [{id, name, ...}]) instead of BUSINESS_ITEM_CATEGORIES dictionary
Alternative: Update ProductsTab.js and InvConfigTab.js to handle the dictionary response and convert to array, or initialize categories state to empty array if API returns non-array
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: ProductsTab.js line 31 does setCategories(c.data) where c.data is a dictionary from /api/inv/categories, then line 73 calls categories.map() causing crash
Fix suggestion: Either backend returns [{id, name}] array OR frontend checks Array.isArray(c.data) before using .map()

bugs_found.issue: Products tab and Config tab crash with TypeError: categories.map is not a function
bugs_found.root_cause: Backend /api/inv/categories returns BUSINESS_ITEM_CATEGORIES dictionary but frontend expects array for .map() call
bugs_found.reproduction_steps: 1. Login as director@sp.com. 2. Navigate to Inventory. 3. Click Products tab. 4. Error overlay appears: categories.map is not a function
bugs_found.suggested_fix: Option A: Change backend /api/inv/categories to query db.inv_categories and return array. Option B: In ProductsTab.js line 31, add: setCategories(Array.isArray(c.data) ? c.data : [])
